Shiki sits on corridor floor to meditate and recover chakra; Kuroda orders he not be bothered except meaningful developments and continues inner ward guard.

Security checks temporary badge found at north stair: records show issued to a female employee of outsourced contractor, but her registered description/name don't match courier's report of dark-clad woman. No proof who used badge or when left it. Search for woman continues, no capture, not necessarily ANBU enemy.

Hospital lab early preliminary on patient's small aliquot finds complex organic fraction with peptide-containing compounds, cannot identify active ingredient, potency or mechanism, cannot prove cause of profound neuromuscular paralysis. Clinician Kazama Ritsu orders baseline blood specimens preserved, keeps UNKNOWN IV continuous, no extra dose administered, on ICU assisted ventilation with circulatory stability and clear consciousness. Results PARTIAL, not complete forensic confirmation.

Shiki remains meditating in ICU corridor on floor, avoiding interruptions while Kuroda guards room. By ~21:04 chakra reserves recovered to near ordinary usable level but not demonstrably 100% or no physical fatigue after heavy fighting, given past major jutsu and rest; no Shiki speech or actions added.

Kuroda returns to corridor with Kusa internal security woman Хаясэ Нори (female, green-black field uniform, pale scar RIGHT cheek, dry operational stance), who checked suspect forged order destination. Kusa Research Building #3 was taken out of regular medical operation in 1281 after coolant system damage and does NOT officially accept patients. Local observer saw unsigned/UNMARKED transport wagon loaded with several long crates on rear service yard, escorted by 2 armed persons, departed building at20:52 headed south toward river crossing. Contents/identity/legality unknown, temporal/locational link plausible but NOT proven conspiracy. Nori dispatched patrol to check wagon route and personally leads group to investigate building; no clear ANBU arrival or command decision. Kuroda and Ritsu independently remain to secure ventilated patient and ongoing IV in ICU. Nori offers Shiki option to accompany investigators but affirms independent Shiki choice to stay guarding; Shiki meditating on floor at cutoff, no forced decision.
